text:
Gabriel Vilardi has two goals in 20 games, and that number is the least informative thing about his season. He has 6.25 expected goals (the quality of his chances), the kind of total that usually comes with five or six goals, and he's shooting 5.1% against a talent range closer to 14.5%. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 99th percentile among forwards for slot chances last season; he still lives there.

Winnipeg has found its feet around him. The Jets lost the first five games of his last ten and won the next five, and Vilardi scored and added two assists in the latest, against Dallas on Nov. 12. He's playing 19 minutes a night lately, up nearly two, and the Jets are better at five on five with him on than off.

Evolving-Hockey had him 34th among 401 forwards last season, with almost four goals of value just from drawing penalties. The goals have been missing, not the player. Watch the shooting percentage; it has a long way to climb toward normal.
headline: Vilardi's chances, without the goals
